p.i: ab his vel ab illis scripta sint, mitigentur, difficultates & dubia omnia tollantur, & sic ansa de hac re unquam litigandi etiam in omnem posteritatem tollatur: quò ita & pax et religio in perpetuum floreat, quæ votorum meorum summa est. Hoc meum ex pacis studio consilium est: Sed ut illud & cordatis & prudentibus & modestis viris non displicebit: ita jam prævideo temerariis & superbis ingeniis nihil magis in votis fore, quàm ut spretis salutaribus pacis & concordiæ consiliis ac monitis [?] in me involent, & virus

page.notes: The "et" after "pax" is a ligature in the scan and read as et [?]. "monitis" is read from a blurred word and is uncertain. The "(?)" beside the page number is an unclear mark, not read as text. The sentence runs on past the page, so the text ends mid-sentence with "virus". Ink spots and scan dirt appear across the page and are not printed text. The "(?)" is not a catchword and was not included.
